scope: Bound typed DRW_VisualStyle callback copies independently of the existing raw DXF companion limits
Account for base table-entry state, descriptions, R2013b strokes, and retained names in all fixed encoding color slots
Connect typed callback record/byte accounting and failure flags to the existing import receipt and export gate
Add generated fast coverage for exact admission, resource classification, source-copy independence, and destination preservation

controls: Typed record and byte totals are recorded separately from raw VISUALSTYLE callback metrics
Import success and the single-import predicate reject typed capture failure, resource-limit failure, count mismatch, and out-of-bound totals
Exact-fit limits admit a generated style; over-budget record and byte cases set typed resource-limit evidence and retain no rejected object
Export refuses before replacing an existing destination when typed capture is incomplete
implementation.limitations: Bounded typed retention and raw pairing do not establish complete style grammar, reference closure, serializer fidelity, cross-version output, or native rendering.

localEvidence: The prior raw VISUALSTYLE capture guard and import-evidence tests remain passing alongside the typed guard.
The new test is generated from in-memory C++ values with a temporary output sentinel; no external or persistent drawing fixture was added.
